title: Ink constellation
summary: Move the pointer to bend a constellation of ink dots. The size and color controls change the live drawing. Reduced motion renders a still constellation.
html:
Catch a little starlight

Move here to bend the ink constellation.
js: export default function mount(root,params,{reducedMotion}) { const canvas=root.querySelector('canvas'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');let p={...params},frame=0,phase=0;const point={x:180,y:110};canvas.width=640;canvas.height=230;function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,640,230);ctx.fillStyle=p.color;for(let i=0;i<24;i++){const angle=i*Math.PI/12+phase;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(point.x+Math.cos(angle)*90,point.y+Math.sin(angle)*60,p.dot_size,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}if(!reducedMotion){phase+=0.004;frame=requestAnimationFrame(draw);}}function move(e){const box=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();point.x=(e.clientX-box.left)*640/box.width;point.y=(e.clientY-box.top)*230/box.height;if(reducedMotion)draw();}canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',move);draw();return {update(next){p={...next};if(reducedMotion)draw();},dispose(){cancelAnimationFrame(frame);canvas.removeEventListener('pointermove',move);}};}
